sources.hist_cs: ema(close, 12) - ema(close, 26) > 0 && ema(close, 12) - ema(close, 26) > (ema(close, 12) - ema(close, 26))[1] ? 0 : ema(close, 12) - ema(close, 26) > 0 && ema(close, 12) - ema(close, 26) < (ema(close, 12) - ema(close, 26))[1] ? 1 : ema(close, 12) - ema(close, 26) < 0 && ema(close, 12) - ema(close, 26) < (ema(close, 12) - ema(close, 26))[1] ? 2 : ema(close, 12) - ema(close, 26) < 0 && ema(close, 12) - ema(close, 26) > (ema(close, 12) - ema(close, 26))[1] ? 3 : 4

meta.name: EMA 12 − EMA 26
meta.description: (the 12-bar exponential average of close) minus (the 26-bar exponential average of close)

meta.name: Close crosses above EMA 20
meta.description: close crossing above (the 20-bar exponential average of close)

meta.name: LINREG 50 · CORRELATION 20 (SPY Close)
meta.description: ((the sum of close over the last 50 bars) divided by 50) plus (((50 times (the 50-bar weighted average of close)) minus (the sum of close over the last 50 bars)) times 0.06)
